messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000628": The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000650": On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000749": As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor.  (about: Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000575": INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000195" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000727": As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000877" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, taking over from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000248": The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000823" [decision]: As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000212" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000312" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
Existing entity names: ledger service, Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade, Ember team, authentication gateway, INC-2025-017, Atlas team, job scheduler, billing API, team Dune, product catalog, Yuki Tanaka, Diego, webhook dispatcher, the cache change, reporting service, INC-2025-011

message.reasoning:
The note is a standup reminder: "[2025-12-29] standup/cinder/2025-12-29: Reminder: auth-gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC."

Existing fact memory_id "1000212" [constraint]: "Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC." (about: authentication gateway)

The note reiterates this constraint. "auth-gateway" is an alias for "authentication gateway". Is this a correction? The note says "deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC" — the existing fact says "deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC". The word "only" adds slight emphasis, but it's essentially the same fact. This is a reminder, not a change. I shouldn't add a contradicting fact or duplicate. Could I add an alias for "auth-gateway" → "authentication gateway"? The alias section is for "A name the note uses for an entity that already exists under another name." Yes, the note uses "auth-gateway" for the existing "authentication gateway". That seems reasonable to record.

Should I add a fact? The note is a reminder of an existing constraint; adding a duplicate fact would be redundant. However, the "only" could be seen as strengthening the constraint. The existing constraint already says deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. The "only" doesn't change anything materially — it restates. I think the safest is: add alias, no new facts (avoid duplication), no corrections (nothing changed).

Alternatively, one might add a correction to include "only". But the existing fact already implies that window is the only deploy window. I'll just add the alias.

   {"name": "auth-gateway", "canonical": "authentication gateway", "evidence": "auth-gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC"}
 ]
}

All arrays must be present? The schema doesn't require them, but better to include all keys with empty arrays for completeness. The instructions say output one JSON object matching the schema. Include all keys.
